name_zh: 黎刹/马科斯/阿基诺/菲律宾人民力量：人民力量革命与精英民主
name_en: Rizal/Marcos/Aquino/Philippine People Power: People Power Revolution & Elite Democracy
description_zh: 菲律宾何塞·黎刹 (1861-1896) 民族英雄/小说唤醒/马科斯 (1917-1989) 1972-1986 戒严/掠夺/阿基诺遇刺/1986 人民力量/科拉松·阿基诺/1991 美军撤离/杜特尔特 2016-2022 毒品战争/小马科斯 2022- 复位。核心模式：人民力量革命 — 非暴力群众/教会/军队倒戈/媒体/中产/精英家族轮替/政治王朝/贫富悬殊/海外劳工。体现 M201 人民力量革命 — 以"非暴力群众+教会中立+军队倒戈+精英家族轮替"四位一体，在殖民/独裁/民主/精英轮替四重历史循环中构建菲式民主。
description_en: Philippines Jose Rizal (1861-1896) national hero/novels awakened/Marcos (1917-1989) 1972-1986 martial law/plunder/Aquino assassinated/1986 People Power/Corazon Aquino/1991 US bases withdrawal/Duterte 2016-2022 drug war/Marcos Jr. 2022- restoration. Core model: People Power Revolution — non-violent masses/church neutrality/military defection/media/middle class/elite family rotation/political dynasties/inequality/OFW. Exemplifies M201 People Power Revolution — quaternity of 'non-violent masses + church neutrality + military defection + elite family rotation' constructing Filipino democracy amid four historical cycles of colonial/dictatorship/democracy/elite rotation.
reason_zh: 菲律宾非单纯民主国家，而是"人民力量+精英家族+海外劳工"三位一体民主循环体。黎刹以小说唤醒，人民力量以非暴力推翻独裁，精英家族轮替维持民主形式，海外劳工支撑经济。M201 区隔于 M196 佛教民族主义(缅甸)、M197 吴哥水利(柬埔寨)、M200 Pancasila(印尼)，核心在于"非暴力群众即民主合法性+精英家族即权力载体+海外劳工即经济支柱"的菲律宾民主范式。
reason_en: Philippines not mere democracy but 'People Power + elite families + OFW' trinity democratic cycle. Rizal awakened via novels, People Power toppled dictatorship non-violently, elite families rotate power, OFWs sustain economy. M201 distinct from M196 Buddhist Nationalism (Myanmar), M197 Angkor Hydraulic (Cambodia), M200 Pancasila (Indonesia), core: 'non-violent masses as democratic legitimacy + elite families as power vehicle + OFWs as economic pillar' Philippine democracy paradigm.
steps_zh: 黎刹小说唤醒民族意识：不敢接触我/起义者/小说/处决/1896 革命/民族英雄/思想先驱
马科斯戒严与掠夺：1972 戒严/贪腐/阿基诺遇刺/伊梅尔达/军队/媒体/经济崩溃/外债/人权侵犯
1986 人民力量革命：埃皮法尼奥大道/百万群众/教会/拉莫斯/埃斯特拉达/军队倒戈/马科斯流亡夏威夷/科拉松执政
精英家族轮替与政治王朝：阿基诺/阿罗约/阿基诺三世/杜特尔特/小马科斯/家族/省长/市长/议员/贫富悬殊/政治王朝法未通过
海外劳工经济支柱：1000 万+ OFW/汇款 300 亿+ 美元/年/10%+ GDP/护士/海员/家政/建筑/中东/东亚/欧美/国家英雄
steps_en: Rizal novels awaken national consciousness: Noli Me Tangere/El Filibusterismo/execution/1896 Revolution/national hero/ideological pioneer
Marcos martial law & plunder: 1972 martial law/corruption/Aquino assassination/Imelda/military/media/economic collapse/external debt/human rights abuses
1986 People Power Revolution: EDSA/million masses/church/Ramos/Estrada/military defection/Marcos exile Hawaii/Corazon presidency
Elite family rotation & political dynasties: Aquino/Arroyo/Aquino III/Duterte/Marcos Jr./families/governors/mayors/legislators/inequality/anti-dynasty bill failed
expected_zh: 以"非暴力群众+教会中立+军队倒戈+精英轮替"四位一体，在殖民/独裁/民主/精英轮替四重循环中构建菲式民主，留下人民力量光环与精英民主实质并存的悖论。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'non-violent masses + church neutrality + military defection + elite rotation' constructs Filipino democracy amid four historical cycles, leaving paradox of People Power aura coexisting with elite democracy substance.
case_zh: 1896 黎刹/1946 独立/1972 戒严/1986 人民力量/1991 美军撤离/2016 杜特尔特/2022 小马科斯/海外劳工/政治王朝/人民力量循环，菲式民主永不终结。
case_en: 1896 Rizal/1946 independence/1972 martial law/1986 People Power/1991 US withdrawal/2016 Duterte/2022 Marcos Jr./OFW/political dynasties/People Power cycle, Filipino democracy never ends.
